basics.name: Peiyu Hu / Hu Peiyu
basics.summary: Generative recommendation researcher working on LLM-enhanced recommender systems, semantic tokenization, multimodal recommendation, and foundation-model-based recommendation infrastructure.

work.name: Xiaohongshu
work.summary: Working on unified generative recommendation foundation models across multiple business scenarios.
highlights: Contributed to the One Model project for unified generative recommendation modeling.
Designed a Mixture-of-Experts architecture to reduce interference and negative transfer in multi-task and multi-scenario training.
Led training and stability tuning with systematic analysis of capacity, expert configuration, and training strategy.

work.name: Shenyang Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
work.summary: Focused on reproducing long-sequence modeling research and building practical deep learning engineering experience.
highlights: Reproduced and trained the Action Chunking Transformer model for long-sequence modeling tasks.
Completed local GPU training, logging, and hyperparameter experiments.

publications.name: Adaptive Semantic Tokenization
publications.summary: Research paper on adaptive semantic tokenization for recommendation-oriented representation learning and generative modeling.

publications.name: From IDs to Semantics: A Generative Framework for Cross-Domain Recommendation with Customized Retrieval-Augmented Generation
publications.summary: A generative cross-domain recommendation framework that combines semantic representations with customized retrieval-augmented generation.

publications.name: LLM for Debiasing Recommendation Unlearning
publications.summary: Research on using large language models to support debiasing in recommendation unlearning.

portfolio.name: UniGenRec
portfolio.description: Unified generative recommendation toolkit covering tokenization, training, inference, multimodal fusion, and reproducible semantic discretization experiments.
